**This summary supersedes an auto-generated digest of a wrong download
(arXiv:1803.10752, a supernova/cosmic-ray physics paper). That content is
gone.**

## The real paper

Crnković, Dean; Maksimović, Marija. "Construction of strongly regular graphs
having an automorphism group of composite order." Contributions to Discrete
Mathematics 15(1) (2020) 22-41. DOI 10.55016/ojs/cdm.v15i1.62323. Only the
abstract is in-library (the download of the PDF was too large / abstract only).

## Findings for the 99-graph (verified from the abstract)

- No SRG(99,14,1,2) with automorphism group of order 6 (Thm 7.2).
- If an SRG(99,14,1,2) exists, the order of its full automorphism group is
  2^a·3^b with b ∈ {0,1} (Thm 7.3); no Z₉ or E₉ group; order-3 automorphism is
  fixed-point-free.
- Rules out Z₆, S₃, Z₉, E₉ as automorphism groups.

## Status

Abstract only in-library; proof detail of the orbit-matrix arguments is a gap.
